descriptions.smoke: One quick theorem for setup and smoke checks.
descriptions.broader: Seven broader fixtures covering Nat distribution, Bool/List recursion, list helpers, tree helpers, and reverse/append.
descriptions.combined: The broader group followed by the heldout group.
descriptions.negative_controls: Six fixtures where generic Nat/List hint candidates should fail Lean before fallback.
descriptions.challenge_v2_no_helper: Three no-expected-proof challenge fixtures requiring local append/map helper lemma discovery.
descriptions.challenge_v3_generalization: Four no-expected-proof theorem-generalization fixtures requiring accumulator generalization and multi-helper proof plans.
descriptions.challenge_transfer: All v2/v3 challenge fixtures for proof-transfer experiments; no expected proofs are bundled.
descriptions.challenge_v4_count: Four no-expected-proof count/list/tree fixtures covering occurrence counting, reverse preservation, tree mirror/flatten, and successor-map-after-reverse.
descriptions.challenge_v5_attribution: Four no-expected-proof fixtures designed to separate seeded, unseeded, and direct repair on simultaneous invariants and multi-helper composition.
descriptions.challenge_v5_tree_tally: The hardest v5 tree/tally mirror fixture for repeated attribution controls.
descriptions.challenge_extended_transfer: All v2/v3/v4/v5/v6/v7/v8/v9/v10 challenge fixtures; no expected proofs are bundled.
descriptions.challenge_v6_frontier: Four no-expected-proof frontier fixtures covering multi-accumulator reverse invariants, nested tree partition stats, successor-map reverse count/sum, and mutually recursive tree depth statistics.
descriptions.challenge_v7_frontier: Four no-expected-proof frontier-plus fixtures combining nested tree partition/filter composition, stats accumulator generalization, mutually recursive traversals, and shifted successor-map statistics.
descriptions.challenge_v8_diagnostics: Four no-expected-proof diagnostic fixtures isolating the v7 partition-heavy accumulator frontier into raw tree stats, keep-side mirror stats, drop-side mirror stats, and list-only partition reassembly.
descriptions.challenge_v9_composition_gradient: Six no-expected-proof composition-gradient fixtures splitting keep/drop partition-through-mirror into scalar length/sum obligations and paired length+sum obligations.
descriptions.challenge_v10_stats_reification: Six no-expected-proof statsAcc-reification fixtures isolating accumulator tuple normalization, metric extensionality, count metrics, and keep/drop stats equality from metric hypotheses.
